entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The Timofei Moșneaga Republican Clinical Hospital is the oldest and largest medical institution in Moldova. The hospital is located in Chișinău and has 772 beds and 22 departments. It serves as the main clinical base for 15 departments and advanced courses of the Nicolae Testemițanu State University of Medicine and Pharmacy.
